ResourceHeader.Description: The CANOPUS Magnetometer and Riometer Array (MARI) was a ground based instrument array for remote sensing the high latitude ionosphere during the ISTP/GGS program. The CANOPUS program has been superseded by the CARISMA (Canadian Array for Realtime Investigations of Magnetic Activity). The CANOPUS riometer array (MARIA) is now Geospace Observatory Canada Widebeam Riometer Network (GO-RIO).
